name: sentinel-swarm
description: A four-role agent swarm, Oracle, Manager, Lead, Coder, that takes a PRD to built, tested, reviewed code. Enforced reviews, a shared ledger, and a scoring rubric hold every role accountable.

test_command.title: Test command
test_command.description: The command sentinel-swarm runs for a file, module, or phase, with {target} in place of what is being tested, for example 'python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider {target}'. Setup uses this value verbatim instead of detecting it from the host repo's stack. Leave it blank to keep detection.
